name: Aminata Diallo
action: Aminata lets her hand settle over the bus ticket in her pocket, gives the tea vendor a small nod without stopping, and turns toward the road to catch the bus.
reason: The smell of tea briefly makes Aminata want it, but she feels the bus ticket in her pocket and notices that her feet are already sore. She decides that if she stops for tea, she will lose the few coins and still get home late, so she concludes that she needs the time more than the cup.
